name: Abomasnow
description: A gentle giant that brings snow wherever it goes.

tricks.label: Snowfall
tricks.desc: A little snow cloud follows it everywhere.

tricks.label: Heavy steps
tricks.desc: It is big. The ground notices when it lands.

name: Abra
description: Sleeps eighteen hours a day and teleports away the moment something startles it.

tricks.label: Teleport
tricks.desc: Pops away to a different spot now and then.

tricks.label: Sleepyhead
tricks.desc: Dozes off twice as fast and takes little naps on its own.

tricks.label: Psychic
tricks.desc: A psychic pulse when it is happy.

name: Absol
description: Misunderstood: it only shows up to warn you. Mostly about deadlines.

tricks.label: Sixth sense
tricks.desc: Turns to face your mouse whenever it comes close.

tricks.label: Dark omen
tricks.desc: A shadowy aura surrounds it at night.

tricks.label: Night watch
tricks.desc: More awake at night: wanders around more and falls asleep later.

name: Ceruledge
description: A wandering swordsman wrapped in ghostly flames. Quiet, but fiercely loyal.

tricks.label: Soul blades
tricks.desc: Its blades burn with a cold blue glow, day and night.

tricks.label: Will-o'-wisps
tricks.desc: Ghostly flames drift around it after dark.

mumbles: My blades are sharp. Your focus should be too.
night: I walk where the shadows go.

name: Darkrai
description: Drifts through the night in a cloak of shadow. Its nightmares are mostly bad jokes.

tricks.label: Drifting
tricks.desc: Hovers just above the ground instead of walking on it.

tricks.label: Dark void
tricks.desc: A swirl of shadow surrounds it at night.

name: Dragonite
description: A kind-hearted giant that flies around the world delivering mail.

tricks.label: Gentle flight
tricks.desc: Floats down softly when you let go, flapping its tiny wings.

tricks.label: Mail carrier
tricks.desc: Proudly announces every new clipboard item, like a delivery.

night: Night flights are the best flights.

name: Eevee
description: Curious and full of potential. Every day it dreams of a different evolution.

tricks.label: Daily dream
tricks.desc: Every day your colors change to the evolution Eevee is dreaming of.

tricks.label: Curious
tricks.desc: Turns to look at your mouse whenever it comes close.

night: The stars look like Sylveon ribbons.

name: Emolga
description: Glides around on its membrane and charms everyone into sharing snacks.

tricks.label: Glider
tricks.desc: Glides gracefully down when you let go, drifting sideways.

tricks.label: Static
tricks.desc: Tiny sparks when it is happy.

name: Gengar
description: Loves pranks and lurking in shadows. That grin is never up to anything good.

tricks.label: Shadow step
tricks.desc: Sometimes melts into the shadows and pops up somewhere else.

tricks.label: Ghostly at night
tricks.desc: Turns see-through after dark and leaves a trail of shadow.

name: Greninja
description: Fast, silent and always a step ahead. Vanishes before you can blink.

tricks.label: Ninja dash
tricks.desc: Runs instead of walking, splashing water as it goes.

tricks.label: Substitute
tricks.desc: Sometimes vanishes in a puff of smoke and pops up somewhere else.

night: Night is a ninja's best friend.

name: Growlithe
description: Loyal, brave and very good at waiting for you to come back.

tricks.label: Loyal
tricks.desc: Jumps for joy and barks when you come back.

tricks.label: Warm embers
tricks.desc: Little embers rise when it is happy.

tricks.label: Curious
tricks.desc: Turns to look at your mouse whenever it comes close.

name: Jigglypuff
description: Sings the sweetest lullabies. Gets very upset if you fall asleep halfway through.

tricks.label: Lullaby
tricks.desc: Little notes float around it, and it hums itself to sleep.

tricks.label: Balloon
tricks.desc: Floats down slowly like a balloon when you let go, rocking from side to side.

name: Jirachi
description: Wakes up to grant wishes. Rumor says it answers one per day.

tricks.label: Floating
tricks.desc: Floats gently above the taskbar.

tricks.label: Shooting stars
tricks.desc: Little stars fall around it at night.

tricks.label: Daily wish
tricks.desc: Click it once a day to make a wish: a big boost of XP.

night: The best wishes happen at night.

name: Lapras
description: A gentle giant that ferries people across the sea and sings to the moon.

tricks.label: Moon song
tricks.desc: Sings softly at night: notes drift up into the dark.

tricks.label: Bubbles
tricks.desc: Blows bubbles, a whole lot of them when it is happy.

tricks.label: Gentle giant
tricks.desc: Big and heavy. The ground notices when it lands.

night: The moon is out. Time to sing.

name: Machamp
description: Four arms, zero rest days. It will make sure you get up and stretch.

tricks.label: Stretch coach
tricks.desc: Reminds you to get up and stretch every hour, even if stretch reminders are off.

tricks.label: Heavy landing
tricks.desc: All muscle. The ground notices when it lands.

mumbles: Drop and give me ten. Or don't.

name: Mewtwo
description: Calm, proud and impossibly strong. It prefers to float above things.

tricks.label: Levitate
tricks.desc: Floats a little above the taskbar, slowly bobbing.

tricks.label: Psychic aura
tricks.desc: A soft purple aura with the occasional psychic pulse.

mumbles: I know what you are thinking.
night: The night is clear. So is my mind.

name: Mudkip
description: Small, strong and always splashing. Its fin senses everything around it.

tricks.label: Splashy
tricks.desc: Droplets fly whenever it's happy or lands.

tricks.label: Hydration buddy
tricks.desc: Reminds you to drink water every 45 minutes, even if water reminders are off.

mumbles: I can feel the rain coming.

name: Pikachu
description: Cheerful, energetic and a little bit static. Better not pet it on a dry day.

tricks.label: Static
tricks.desc: Little sparks crackle around it, a lot more when you drag it around.

tricks.label: Curious
tricks.desc: Turns to look at your mouse whenever it comes close.

name: Psyduck
description: Has a headache that never quite goes away. When it gets bad, strange things happen.

tricks.label: Headache
tricks.desc: Psychic waves pulse out of its aching head now and then.

tricks.label: Splashy
tricks.desc: Droplets fly whenever it's happy.

tricks.label: Blank stare
tricks.desc: Stares at your mouse whenever it comes close.

night: My head hurts less at night.

name: Snorlax
description: Big, gentle and always up for a nap. Nothing gets between Snorlax and a snack.

tricks.label: Heavy sleeper
tricks.desc: Dozes off twice as fast, takes little naps on its own and snores loudly.

tricks.label: Earthshaker
tricks.desc: Landings shake the ground. Good luck throwing it far.

night: Perfect night for a big nap.

name: Sudowoodo
description: Pretends to be a tree. Freezes the moment you come close. It is not a tree.

tricks.label: Playing tree
tricks.desc: Freezes on the spot when your mouse comes close. Totally a tree.

tricks.label: Falling leaves
tricks.desc: A leaf drifts down from it now and then.

name: Umbreon
description: Calm, loyal and wide awake at night. Its rings glow softly in the moonlight.

tricks.label: Moonlight glow
tricks.desc: The rings glow between 7 pm and 6 am, even brighter while sleeping.

tricks.label: Night owl
tricks.desc: More awake at night: wanders around more and falls asleep later.

mumbles: Rest your eyes for a sec?

name: Zeraora
description: Fast as lightning and twice as restless. Leaves sparks wherever it runs.

tricks.label: Lightning dash
tricks.desc: Runs instead of walking and leaves a trail of sparks.

tricks.label: Plasma glow
tricks.desc: The cyan markings glow with electricity.
